content.text:
The happy place.

The beauty of life lies not in safety, but the conatus or the will to live and be the best we can. Somehow I feel this will is the strongest when our mind is fixated at some work we take pride in or feel greatly obliged to. 

The ship is safe at the harbour, but that's not what it is meant for, the essence of being is not that it exists but what it is not, it is our duty as humans to do the best for ourselves, to do with all pride what we believe in with all our heart and might. Humans are not institutional creatrues by the very being, we have a sense of creativeness or an inward striving for the natural tendencies like a higher dignity, beauty or courage. This is what I think one of the most determining factors in a good life, the coherence of our actions with our intellectual and moral appetations.

Never bet against youselves.

One of the things that I have learn't the hard way is that it is essential to back youselves all the times, both in crysis and in pride. It is the very duty towards our ownselves, to uphold our ouwn dignity both moral and psychological. One shouldn't bow doen to a principle or a moral just for the sake of soundness. This is contrary to Buddha, according to him, if someone says something to you, you shouldn't take it to your heart and think of them as misguided mortals intertwined in the worldly. 

Well, I must confess that I am no Buddha, I believe that my psychological and moral comfort is prior to broad principles. So I uphold that if someone strikes you once, you have an obligation towards your psyche to strike twice. Dont be Buddha if your're not, the least we can guarantee out of such a situation is the absence of cognitive dissonance.
If my mum had balls, she'd be my dad.

Max Emilian Verstappen is a Dutch and Belgian racing driver who competes under the Dutch flag in Formula One for Red Bull Racing. Verstappen has won four Formula One World Drivers' Championship titles, which he won consecutively from 2021 to 2024 with Red Bull, and has won 71 Grands Prix across 12 seasons.
